My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
Many, many thanks[.] the birthday[^2] for which the Heroes were wanted comes tomorrow, so nothing can be more convenient.

The [Lances](/book/23) look very well

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: CMY’s nephew, [Francis Arthur Yonge](/person/1607) was going to be seven on 23 November 1868.
